marketLayer.title: HK Tech Sector & AI Monetization
marketLayer.fact: The Hang Seng Tech Index rose 1.8% during trading, supported by major Chinese tech giants publishing stronger-than-expected cloud revenue growth and increased enterprise AI adoption figures.
marketLayer.inference: Institutional capital is re-entering HK tech equities as AI infrastructure investments begin delivering measurable revenue conversion rather than purely capital expenditure drag.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Escalating US semiconductor export restrictions and potential delays in localized chip production.

marketLayer.title: US Macro Policy & Treasury Yield Movements
marketLayer.fact: US benchmark 10-year Treasury yields dropped 5 basis points as recent producer price index data indicated cooling wholesale inflation, boosting market odds of a Fed rate cut.
marketLayer.inference: Easing risk-free rates provide valuation support for US mega-cap tech stocks and encourage global capital reallocation toward higher-yielding emerging market assets.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Sticky consumer inflation metrics and potential hawkish rhetoric in upcoming Federal Reserve speeches.

marketLayer.title: Chinese Electric Vehicle Market Dynamics
marketLayer.fact: Major Chinese EV manufacturers posted over 20% year-over-year delivery growth for the recent month, buoyed by domestic trade-in subsidies and expanding European retail channels.
marketLayer.inference: Robust volume momentum helps mitigate profitability pressures stemming from domestic price competition and overseas tariff adjustments.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Implementation details of foreign trade barriers and sustainability of domestic consumer stimulus programs.
